description: Top 5 and bottom 5 politicians (Congress + executive-branch officials) by ESTIMATED trading P&L over a trailing window (default and only supported window: 90 days), plus SPY's return over the same window as a benchmark, and imageUrl — a ready-to-attach 2160x2700 PNG card of the same ranking (null when unavailable; card.reason says why). ALL P&L FIGURES ARE ESTIMATES (estimate: true, estimateRange "±25–40%"): disclosed amount RANGES are converted to shares at the historical close, FIFO-matched, and open positions marked to the latest quote. State that they are estimates whenever you publish them; the card already prints "Estimates from disclosed amount ranges (±25–40%). Not investment advice." WHAT THE METRIC IS (read `metric`): P&L on trades DISCLOSED INSIDE the window only — realized on round trips opened and closed in the window plus unrealized on positions opened in the window. It is NOT lifetime P&L; sales of positions bought before the window are not counted. Eligibility: at least 5 trades in the window (eligibility.minTradesInWindow), so a single lucky trade cannot top the board. Each row: slug, fullTitle ("Senator", "Representative", or an executive official's filed title), fullName, displayName, party and state as full words, estimatedPnl, winRate (0-1; null = no position closed in the window — not measured, never 0%), tradesInWindow, unrealizedMeasured, and portraitUrl (always null for executive officials). Use the full title and full party/state words — never "Sen." or "D-CA". benchmark.available false means SPY was NOT measured (benchmark.reason) — never 0%. available false with reason "pending" means the window has not been computed yet, not that nobody traded.

window.description: Trailing window in days. Only 90 is supported (default 90).
